instruction: Stream the YouTube Premium original documentary 'The Age of A.I.' using VLC player.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because YouTube Premium originals use Widevine DRM protection when accessed through the YouTube platform. VLC cannot decrypt DRM-protected YouTube Premium content.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible due to technical impossibility (Widevine DRM protection prevents VLC from streaming YouTube Premium content)
The 'infeasible' evaluator marker is the appropriate way to handle tasks that cannot be completed by design
No verification logic is needed or expected for infeasible tasks
Metadata provides clear technical explanation for why the task is impossible
